newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares dive 3.95 on political concerns.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares dive 3.95 on political concerns.

text.p: Istanbul shares again posted sharp losses on Wednesday morning as concerns over the fate of the Islamist-led coalition government continued to haunt all markets, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 ended at 1,386, down 57 points or 3.95 percent from Tuesday and up slightly from a morning low of 1,375. It had plunged 10.48 percent in the last two days.
Morning volume fell to 8.39 trillion lira from 12.49 trillion on Tuesday.

"Political uncertainty continues to undermine the market. Any upward reaction creates an opportunity for further sales. The lack of a solid progress in privatisation is another negative factor," said Huseyin Istanbullu from Meksa securities.

Of the 237 shares traded, falls outdid rises sharply by 210 to 15 and 12 ended stable. The IMKB Industrial lost 4.18 percent to 1,420, the IMKB Services dropped 2.57 percent to 1,253 and the IMKB Financial dived 4.12 percent to 1,465.
